SyntheticHanaModel.name: CV_INVOICE_SALES
SyntheticHanaModel.description: Original synthetic fixture. Fictional company: Northstar Supply. Not exported from or validated in HANA, Qlik or Spotfire. No company data or real BI dashboard is represented.
SyntheticHanaModel.RelationalDefinition: SELECT i.INVOICEID, l.INVOICELINEID, i.ORDERID, i.INVOICEDATE, c.CUSTOMERID, c.CUSTOMERNAME, p.STOCKITEMID, p.STOCKITEMNAME, l.QUANTITY, l.EXTENDEDPRICE - l.TAXAMOUNT AS INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX, l.TAXAMOUNT AS INVOICE_TAX, l.EXTENDEDPRICE AS INVOICE_TOTAL_INCL_TAX FROM INVOICELINES l JOIN INVOICES i ON l.INVOICEID = i.INVOICEID JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON i.CUSTOMERID = c.CUSTOMERID JOIN STOCKITEMS p ON l.STOCKITEMID = p.STOCKITEMID
